description: Start two or more processes and arrange them on screen together in a new DevGlow workspace. PREFER this over repeated run_process calls whenever you are starting more than one process — the user does not have to ask to see them. Repeated run_process calls leave each process sitting in the sidebar until the user clicks it into a pane, so starting three that way makes the app look like nothing happened. Each process here starts exactly as run_process would. Always creates a new workspace: a name that already exists gets a numbered variant, and no existing workspace is ever modified, so a repeat call cannot disturb the user's arrangement. DevGlow chooses the split layout from its own window size; you cannot specify one. If DevGlow is closed it will be launched.

name.description: Name for the new workspace, as the user will see it in the sidebar. Describe the group, not one process (e.g. 'api stack', 'checkout debug').

processes.description: Processes to start, in the order they should appear on screen. Panes beyond DevGlow's 8-pane cap still run; they just wait in the sidebar.

description.description: What this process is, plus any notes worth keeping (max 1000 chars).

interactive.description: Force PTY (interactive terminal) mode for this process. Omit — the command is auto-detected (flutter run, expo start, metro ⇒ on).

name.description: Display name. Do NOT include the port number.

port.description: Port the process listens on. Check package.json scripts for --port flags.

name: workspace_run

arranged.description: Processes placed in the new workspace. 0 means no workspace was created.

id.description: AI process id, for get_logs, stop_project and delete_process.

last_exit_reason.description: Last log line before it exited, when it exited right after start.

port_conflict.description: Set when the port was already taken; the process was registered but not started.

state.description: running: up. error: registered but not running (port conflict, or it exited right after start). pending: registered, not confirmed running yet. unknown: DevGlow had not registered it when the wait ran out, so do not rely on the id.

workspace_requested.description: The name you asked for. DevGlow numbers it if a workspace with that name exists.

title: Run processes in a new workspace
